capabilities: Render a live resume preview from a Markdown template file
Export the rendered resume as a PDF to a chosen destination
Generate hyperlinked contact properties (email, phone, LinkedIn, GitHub)
Format job and project entries from heading separators like | and :
Treat plain text lines as tag-list items and unused headings as comments
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation instructions describe cloning the repository into the plugins folder in addition to community-plugin install.
motivation: The author spent many hours fighting resume formatting in Google Docs and Word and built the plugin because Markdown is consistent.
problem: Obsidian has no way to turn a Markdown note into a properly formatted, submission-ready resume, and word processors make resume formatting inconsistent.
summary: Resume builder that renders a Markdown template file into a formatted resume preview and exports it as a print-ready PDF.
